description: Source file implementing configuration handling and environment variable parsing for trace2, including pattern matching and callback mechanisms.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_load_patterns
methods.description: Loads configuration patterns from environment variable TR2_SYSENV_CFG_PARAM.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_patterns
methods.description: Frees the list of configuration patterns.

methods.name: tr2_load_env_vars
methods.description: Loads environment variable names from environment variable TR2_SYSENV_ENV_VARS.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_env_vars
methods.description: Frees the list of environment variable names.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_cb
methods.description: Callback to check if a key matches any pattern and logs it.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_list_config_fl
methods.description: Lists configuration based on patterns, called with filename and line number.

methods.name: tr2_list_env_vars_fl
methods.description: Lists environment variables, called with filename and line number.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_set_fl
methods.description: Sets a configuration key-value pair, called with filename and line number.
